rationale: B wins because it knows where the facts stop. A smuggles unsupplied market context into "Expedia, Kayak, and Hopper have bolted AI planners onto their products," then asks the founder to fact-check the landmine after making it the frame. B's "Going's AI trip planner reverses how travel planning works: the fare picks the destination, not the traveler" is a cleaner, pitchable thesis, and its refusal of "How Going competes with Google Flights, Expedia, and AI travel assistants" shows discipline A lacked.
gaps_in_A: "Expedia, Kayak, and Hopper have bolted AI planners onto their products" is outside the supplied facts. Maybe true, maybe not; either way it cannot be load-bearing in a blind angle set.
"different from every other AI trip planner" in the next step overstates the supported claim. The update supports fare-alert-to-itinerary; it does not support category-wide superiority or uniqueness.

"The company once known as Scott's Cheap Flights just built an AI travel app" inflates a Premium-only trip planner into an app-level reinvention story. The rebrand arc may exist, but the update only gives "formerly Scott's Cheap Flights."
Angle 2's "AI agents will book your whole trip" narrative is a useful skeptical frame, but A correctly admits it still needs proof. Until then, it is a strawman with nice shoes.
gaps_in_B: "the core product — cheap-fare alerts — is free to ~2 million people" is a little too confident. The update says Going has ~2 million free members, not that the full core alert product is free in the way the angle implies.
"founder-profile" is a shaky label when no founder facts, founder name, or founder availability were supplied. Call it company evolution unless the founder is actually part of the evidence.
"A consumer tech reporter at a general tech publication" is broader than it should be. The sharper home is travel-tech product coverage or a reviewer comparing AI travel workflows.
"reverses how travel planning works" is a strong headline, but it needs proof that destination-first planning is the real default. Good angle, but don't let the flourish outrun the evidence.
